title: When Exact Token Importance Is Not Enough: Limits of Top-K Selection in LLM Attention
abstract: arXiv:2611.32324v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-context language models often retain only a limited set of past token positions for an attention query. A common strategy scores positions individually and keeps the highest-ranked K. Yet attention weights are renormalized over the chosen set: two individually important positions need not form the best pair. We ask whether independent ranking suffices even when each importance score measures the exact downstream change in next-token predictions caused by deleting that position alone. It does not. A four-position construction makes the ranked pair incur 133.2 times the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence of the optimal pair, and a parametric family proves that this multiplicative gap is unbounded. An exact exchange identity and preference reversals for every K >= 2 explain the interaction. translated_title: 当精确的词元重要性不够时：大语言模型注意力中Top-K选择的局限性
translated_abstract: 长上下文语言模型在进行注意力查询时，通常只保留有限的过去词元位置集合。一种常见策略是对各位置单独打分并保留排名最高的K个。然而，注意力权重会在所选集合上重新归一化：两个单独来看很重要的位置，未必能构成最佳的组合。我们探究了这样一个问题：即使每个重要性得分精确度量了仅删除该位置时对下一词元预测造成的下游变化，独立排名是否仍然足够。答案是否定的。一个四位置构造表明，按排名选出的组合所产生的Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度是最优组合的133.2倍，而一个参数化族则证明这一乘性差距是无界的。一个精确的交换恒等式，以及针对每个K >= 2 都存在的偏好反转现象，解释了这种交互作用。在对SmolLM2、Gemma和Qwen的穷举式冻结模型审计中，精确单点评分的Top-4在完整枚举下仍留有至少10%的相对改进空间……
tldr: 本文证明了即使采用精确的单点删除效应作为词元重要性评分，Top-K独立排名选择仍会次优，因为注意力归一化引入的位置间交互可使排名组合与最优组合之间的KL散度差距高达133.2倍且在理论上无界。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that Top-K selection remains suboptimal even with exact per-token importance scores, since attention renormalization creates token interactions that make the gap between ranked and optimal subsets as large as 133.2× in KL divergence and provably unbounded.
